title: Add countryCode to shipped transporter records
summary: Every shipped record in TRANSPORTER_OPTIONS (animals only) carried a free-text country name but no ISO countryCode; the backend's Address DTO reads only countryCode, so picking a shipped transporter submitted a notification with carrier.postalAddress.countryId null, the suspected root cause of nightly dynamics-gateway DLQ failures. Commit 39c3cb84 adds countryCode to all six shipped records, matching the shape privateTransporter() already produces for a hand-typed transporter. The alignment branch never touches src/server/app/services/transporters/ at all, so this is a clean, zero-conflict merge.

animals: 39c3cb84 fix(EUDPA-620): add countryCode to shipped transporter records (#364)

files.note: Adds `countryCode` to the privateRecord() destructure/shape and to the two shipped-commercial records that carried a bare `country` string (Switzerland → CH, Belgium → BE).
Test assertions for the new countryCode field.

branchEquivalent.evidence: `git diff --name-status -M <mergeBase> origin/feat/NO_JIRA-frontend-alignment -- src/server/app/services/transporters/records.js src/server/app/services/transporters/transporters.test.js` returns no output in the animals clone — the branch has no commit touching this directory at all, and plants/ins have no equivalent transporters service (transporters are a live-animals-only concept).

verdictWhy: Zero branch interaction. A merge of main into the branch carries this fix through unchanged; no file it touches appears anywhere in the animals conflict list.
behaviourChanges: No behaviour change introduced by the merge itself — the fix (shipped transporters now carry countryCode so the backend's Address DTO resolves carrier.postalAddress.countryId) is unaffected by anything the branch does.

claims.statement: The fix adds countryCode to privateRecord()'s shape and to the two shipped-commercial records (Switzerland, Belgium) that previously carried only a free-text country name.
The branch does not touch the transporters service directory at all — the merge is a pure pass-through.
The commit's own message states the DTO-shape mismatch that caused the defect and names the reference shape it now matches.
claims.quote:
The backend's Address DTO only reads countryCode
(an ISO alpha-2 code) — the free-text country field is a retired
shape. Picking any shipped transporter therefore submitted a
notification with carrier.postalAddress.countryId null, believed to
be the root cause of nightly DLQ failures in dynamics-gateway.

Adds the correct countryCode to all six shipped records, matching the
shape private-transporter-details.controller.js's privateTransporter()
already produces for a hand-typed transporter.
